ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Nimit Rajesh Ghatalia converted 150,000 warrants into equity shares of Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd, increasing their non-promoter stake from 4.88% to 5.18% of the company's voting capital and triggering this disclosure. This conversion resulted in share dilution as the company's total equity capital increased significantly from 30.72 million to 31.87 million shares. A critical red flag is the stated acquisition date of September 30, 2026, implying either a highly unusual forward-looking disclosure for an event several years away or a material clerical error in the filing.
